# splunkctl rules

Manage detection rules (saved searches).

## rules create

Create a saved search.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl rules create [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | - | Saved search name. [required] |
| `--search` | text | - | SPL query. [required] |
| `--cron` | text | - | Cron schedule. |
| `--app` | text | - | Splunk app context. |
| `--description` | text | - | Description. |
| `--actions` | text | - | Alert actions (comma-separated). |
| `--disabled` | flag | false | Create disabled. |
| `--earliest` | text | - | dispatch.earliest_time (e.g. -24h). |
| `--latest` | text | - | dispatch.latest_time (e.g. now). |
| `--alert-type` | choice: custom, number of events, number of hosts, number of sources | - | Alert trigger type (defaults to 'number of events' when a comparator is set). |
| `--alert-comparator` | choice: greater than, less than, equal to, not equal to, drops by, rises by | - | Trigger comparator (requires --alert-threshold). |
| `--alert-threshold` | text | - | Trigger threshold (number or percentage). |
| `--severity` | integer range | - | Alert severity 1 (info) to 6 (fatal). |
| `--throttle` | integer | - | Throttle window in seconds. |
| `--throttle-fields` | text | - | Comma-separated fields to throttle by. |
| `--track / --no-track` | flag | - | List firings under triggered alerts. |
| `--schedule-window` | text | - | Scheduler window in minutes, or 'auto'. |
| `--email-to` | text | - | Email action recipient(s) (action.email.to); does not enable the action by itself — pass --actions email too. Conflicts with --set action.email.to. |
| `--email-subject` | text | - | Email action subject (action.email.subject). Conflicts with --set action.email.subject. |
| `--webhook-url` | text | - | Webhook action URL (action.webhook.param.url); does not enable the action by itself — pass --actions webhook too. Conflicts with --set action.webhook.param.url. |
| `--set` | text | - | Raw saved-search field KEY=VALUE (repeatable); --email-to/--email-subject/--webhook-url conflict with their equivalent --set fields (exit 2), not override. |

## rules delete

Delete a saved search.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl rules delete [OPTIONS] NAME
```

## rules disable

Disable scheduling for a saved search.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text

```

## rules enable

Enable scheduling for a saved search.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text

```

## rules export

Export saved searches to a YAML file.

```text

```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | file | - | Output YAML file. [required] |
| `--name` | text | - | Export specific rules (repeatable). |
| `--app` | text | - | Filter by app context. |

## rules get


| `--owner` | text | - | Splunk owner context. |

## rules history

```text

```

## rules import

Import saved searches from a YAML file.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl rules import [OPTIONS]
```

```text
Dry-run previews create/update/unchanged per rule with field-level
diffs on stderr. Pass ``--json``/``--format json`` to also get a
full, untruncated JSON diff array on stdout: one object per rule,
``{"name", "action", "changes": [{"field", "old", "new"}], "reason"}``
(on skip only). Action is one of ``create`` | ``update`` | ``unchanged``
| ``skip``; ``old`` is null for ``create``, ``changes`` is empty for
``unchanged`` and ``skip``. Exits non-zero when any rule is skipped or
fails, so CI pipelines cannot silently pass a broken detections file.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | file | - | YAML file with rule definitions. [required] |
| `--update / --no-update` | flag | true | Update existing rules (default: yes). |

## rules list

List all saved searches.

```text
splunkctl rules list [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | - | Only saved searches in this app (default: current namespace, which may miss app-private rules — pass --app to see them). |
| `--owner` | text | - | Only saved searches owned by this user (default: current namespace). |
| `--scheduled` | flag | false | Show only scheduled saved searches. |
| `--limit` | integer range | - | Return at most N entries (default: all). |
| `--offset` | integer range | 0 | Skip the first N entries. |
| `--filter` | text | - | Case-insensitive name substring; --limit/--offset then apply to the filtered set. |

## rules schedule

Show scheduling info for saved searches (scheduler health).

```text
splunkctl rules schedule [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | - | Only saved searches in this app. |
| `--owner` | text | - | Only saved searches owned by this user. |
| `--limit` | integer range | - | Return at most N entries (default: all). |
| `--offset` | integer range | 0 | Skip the first N entries. |
| `--filter` | text | - | Case-insensitive name substring; --limit/--offset then apply to the filtered set. |

## rules share

Change a saved search's sharing level (ACL).

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl rules share [OPTIONS] NAME
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--sharing` | choice: user, app, global | - | Target sharing level. [required] |
| `--owner` | text | - | New owner (defaults to current). |

## rules test

Dispatch a rule now (backfill/test run) without firing alert actions.

```text
splunkctl rules test [OPTIONS] NAME
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--earliest` | text | - | Override dispatch window start. |
| `--latest` | text | - | Override dispatch window end. |
| `--limit` | integer | 100 | Max results (default 100). |
